story: Varnadeepam brings together three elongated lanterns in glowing shades of red, amber, and green. Their rectangular forms are framed with ornamental wooden borders, recalling the warm character of old verandahs, traditional passageways, and handcrafted Indian lanterns.
tagline: Three colours of light, suspended in one heritage rhythm.
name: Varnadeepam
price: Set of 3 - ₹20,000 · Single - ₹7,500 · Complete set with brass - ₹35,000
dimensions: Large: 18 in (1.6 ft) · Medium: 15 in (1.3 ft) · Small: 12 in (1 ft)
